learning_outcomes.text: Students can grasp, analyze, and evaluate overarching issues related to lightweight construction concepts and designs, as well as the associated materials and manufacturing processes in the context of sustainability.

Students can methodically analyze and evaluate problems by combining management and economic methods with technical engineering methods to propose correct solutions and make decisions. Further competencies in leadership, communication, self-management, conflict, and change management complete the engineering studies by addressing the "soft" aspects, to successfully manage both the "what" and the "how" in professional life.

syllabus_topics: Methods and tools in lightweight construction
NACHHALTIGE FERTIGUNG: Fundamentals of sustainable manufacturing processes

Students can understand and analyze economic and management-related requirements in addition to the technical aspects of engineering studies, so that they can make and critically question entrepreneurial decisions, and later evaluate and optimize the procedures in their business processes.

Students use classic consulting approaches and tools by applying methodical approaches and procedures in change projects meaningfully to set up (design) and implement (sustainability) change initiatives.

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (MABB721 Leichtbau und nachhaltige Fertigung)

assessment_rules: Due to the different topics and lecture times, the subjects are not examined as a module exam, but individually. For MABB721 and MABB722, students can choose between a 60-minute written exam or a 20-minute presentation.
